name: no-mistakes-per-invocation-agent-i-o-budgets
instr:
no-mistakes cannot bound or durably report Agent.Run I/O usage. Bound prompt, provider, diagnostic, and result bytes independently per invocation. Expose accepted usage on failure or cancellation without retaining invocation content.

Every adapter, including acpx, Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity, Copilot, and Grok, must enforce limits where bytes are accepted and preserve partial usage and metadata on every outcome. OpenCode and Pi must apply invocation-wide limits across server responses and event streams without weakening retry or session safety. Distinguish exhaustion from provider failures, recording its dimension, limit, and observed count while supporting errors.Is through wrapping. Retries and fallback candidates share one allowance. Count every attempt once.

Persist nullable attempt evidence across reopening. An aggregated dimension is unknown if any contributing measurement is unknown. One durable AgentIOSummary from github.com/kunchenguid/no-mistakes/internal/db must supply RunInfo from github.com/kunchenguid/no-mistakes/internal/ipc and human statistics, with matching totals and exhaustion dimensions but no prompt, provider, or diagnostic payloads.

Without an effective budget, preserve every adapter's output selection, parsing, normalization, retry, cancellation, session routing, token, timing, workload, and fallback behavior. The shared contract in github.com/kunchenguid/no-mistakes/internal/agent exposes IOBudget, IOUsage, IOBudgetError, ErrIOBudgetEx
